correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed sample rank clipping for real n-vectors and integer 1<=a<b<=n, strict order chamber coordinate-replication multiplicities a and n-b+1 (others singleton), and exact all-cut Gini norm. Verified nonstandard replication lemma: for any m_j>=n/2 choose S or its complement containing j, then mass phi(u)<=phi(m_j); otherwise all m_j<n/2 and choose cut side with u>=s, select j in S with m_j>=u/s and use phi monotonicity and the algebraic inequality n(s-1)(u/s-1)>=0 to bound arbitrary cuts by a singleton. Discrete coarea yields global bound and single-pivot rank perturbation attains max{a(n-a),(n-b+1)(b-1)}/(n-1). Pairwise one-input clipping contraction is distinct. Independently enumerated all integer replication multiplicity compositions of n for 2<=n<=7 (3,10,35,126,462,1716 compositions) and every nontrivial binary cut, all agreeing with the lemma; checked rank boundary formulas and trivial a=1,b=n. No inference from a finite test to all dimensions.
